{{Top|leg}}
'''Pesticide dispensers''' were devices used by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to dispense chemical [[pesticide]]s. [[Pest-control droid]]s, such as the [[TS-Arach series Pest Control Droid]], used pesticide dispensers to eliminate common pests that threatened the crops they were assigned to patrol.
